expr: (() => { const S=window.simState; return S.galaksi===1 && S.d===22 && S.H0===50 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: on load: galaxy 1 at 22 Mpc, the line's slope 50 km/s/Mpc (must run before any setup)
galaxy 1: Hα at 656,3 · (1 + z) = 660,24 nm (lesson-answers g1-lam)
slope 50 km/s/Mpc: 1/H0 = 3,086e19 km / 50 km/s = 19,56 · 10⁹ a (lesson-answers sim-age-start)

expr: (() => { const L=[...document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root select')].map(s=>[...s.options].map(o=>o.value).join(',')); const R=document.querySelector('#sim-root input[type=range]'); return L.length===2 && L[0]==='1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8' && L[1]==='0.5,1,2' && R && +R.min===40 && +R.max===100 && +R.step===1 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: controls: galaxy 1–8, speed hidas/normaali/nopea, slope slider 40–100 km/s/Mpc in steps of 1

expr: (() => { const n=document.querySelectorAll('#sim-root p.note'); return !document.querySelector('#sim-root details') && n.length===1 && n[0].textContent.trim().split(/\s+/).length<=15 ? 1 : 0 })()
note: no Lisätietoja box; one legend line of at most 15 words

expr: (() => { const c=document.querySelector('#sim-root canvas'); const w=document.getElementById('sim-root').clientWidth; return c.width===600 && c.height===(w<500?1100:400) ? 1 : 0; })()
note: canvas 600x400 on a wide screen, 600x1100 (stacked, larger labels) under 500 px
the readout shows d in Mpc, λ = 660,2 nm with a decimal comma and v in km/s
